title: _Imperial_-Class Star Destroyer
caption: _Imperial_-Class Star Destroyer (V)
game_text: Deploys -3 to same location as a unique (•) Star Destroyer. May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Ship-docking]
lore: Mainstay of Imperial Navy. 1.6 kilometers long. Has hangars and facilities for TIE fighter squadrons, shuttles, drop-ships and combat vehicles such as AT-ATs and AT-STs.
